notes.title: Kind Words is Now Connected to Kind Words 2
notes.notes:
Maybe you've noticed I've been updating Kind Words a lot lately. It's all been in preparation for today!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/]Kind Words 2 is now available![/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/83f4fa23735c6c93477d30a505af34cd64dab9f4.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What does this change for the original Kind Words?[/h2]

[list]
[*] More players
[*] More stickers
[/list]
The sequel contains a remaster of the original that runs on the very same server. That means every new Kind Words 2 player is automatically a Kind Words player.

You will be seeing their requests, responses and airplanes! 

Because of you, Kind Words is such an amazing community. We wouldn't dream of splitting it. Two games, one warm internet hug.

Also stickers. Every new sticker for Kind Words 2 is also coming to Kind Words. The first batch already made its way in to circulation during the Kind Words 2 playtests. But today a new batch of 12 stickers will start making their way to your inboxes.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/01f4e4739cfa8a3429e09ce933cd730f942603ff.gif[/img][/url]

[h2]What's the difference between the two games?[/h2]

Most of the design of Kind Words 2 was inspired by observing what Kind Words players were trying to do in Kind Words, but that just didn't fit the space.

If you've played a lot of Kind Words, you may have run in to off-topic expressions of joy, creativity, invitations to vent or questions about movies and games. These are all great things to share with people and it always hurts to moderate them away. But the design of Kind Words is so focused on requests for comfort, responses and airplanes, that if we didn't do something, the globally shared inbox could fill up with unanswerable messages.

So Kind Words 2 has new, virtual spaces to handle all the quirky and joyful expressions that players have been trying to find a home for for the last 5 years. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/b26b5c4759b37ae1a07950d4cd32ca6b5f9ffb49.gif[/img][/url]

I could go on, but I don't want to run afoul of Valve's cross-promotion rules :)  The headliner [i]here[/i] is: The game you already own, Kind Words, just got a bit more awesome today.

Thanks for being on this ride with us.


Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/34d0e9971ae25988f5342105827499f6edbf7059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/2b9fca7d61ca278afe2fb04f92d1357bf7e3699e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Sticker Shrink and Favorites Fix
notes.notes:
Stickers:
Now that there are SEVENTY FIVE stickers in the game, we have to be a little more mindful about the space on disk and memory that they take up. This update uses some smarter compression options that won't change how they look but will reduce the game's build size by about 80mb.

Favorites:
Thanks to the multiple users who reported a softlock if you tried to view the favorites page before you've ever favorited anything. The old favorites system used to take a little time to check if you have no favorites. In a recent update I made it super fast to check your favorite count. Yay! Except that the system was expecting at least one frame of delay when checking. I made it so fast it broke. I'm the greatest?

notes.title: Fixed a missing stickers bug
notes.notes:
With apologies to the many users who got a little scared when their stickers disappeared, I present this humble bug fix.

Your stickers were never really gone. They were always in your hearts. But I understand that you wanted them on your screen too. So that's where they should be now.

Also, things get less weird now if your internet keeps turning on and off. 

That's what the whole sticker bug was about. The game would lose connection with the server and the game's response was not "Remain calm. it will be ok. These things happen." it was "Forget all stickers". 

Should be better now.

Yours,
Ziba

notes.title: Slicker Sticker Picker
notes.notes:
The slicker sticker picker is also quicker. 

Don't worry, the cute sticker sheets are still there when you're decorating your room. But when you're choosing which sticker to send to somebody, there's a much faster way to review your adorable inventory.

But why, 5 years after launch and a year since the last update, would we push a seemingly small quality-of-life update?

A) Because we love you
B) It's actually a much bigger update

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/]Kind Words 2 is coming[/url] and it will run on the same server as Kind Words. People playing KW2 will be sending you letters with new stickers they find. That means the original Kind Words needs to be able to understand what the heck is attached to those letters. 

Also, since there's no room associated with the new sticker, Kind Words needs a new interface for you to enjoy the sticker and to choose it if you want to gift it to someone else.

Therefore:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/9b632b47ae1f7ddd90e4ad5fbb6f22e7343552e8.jpg[/img]

The behind the scenes magic is this: stickers no longer have to be built in to the game. We can add new stickers to the server and the game will know what to do.

In fact, this update brings in 3 years of work we've done on the component of Kind Words 2 that talks to the server. We rewrote how the game talks to the server for greater reliability, efficiency and flexibility. And now Kind Words and Kind Words 2 share the same "client library". This is an important part of our commitment to supporting both games for a long time. 

This update also uses the latest stable version of the Unity game engine. 

Also, I fixed a silly typo on the help screen. Thanks to the multiple users who pointed it out. Spelling has never been my strong suit. Good thing my job requires me to write things lots of people read.

Oh, and KW2 playtesting will open up again pretty soon. So [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/]sign up[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118120/Kind_Words_2_lofi_city_pop/]wishlist[/url] and say hi on our [url=http://discord.gg/popcannibal]discord[/url].

Cheers,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Our Favorite Update!
notes.notes:
Ok, now this is just getting silly. Kind Words has been out for four years and people are still writing [i][b]THOUSANDS OF LETTERS EVERY DAY[/b][/i].

Well then, I guess we'll keep updating it!

Thanks to the big server overhaul we did last month, we can add something people have been asking for from the very beginning: 

[h2]Favorites![/h2]

You can now [i][b]curate a collection of your favorite airplanes and letters[/b][/i] that you have received. 

See an airplane you want to hold on to? Click favorite. Don't worry, You're making a copy. Its good vibes will still float on to the next person.

Really love a response you got and don't want to dig through your whole inbox to re-read it every time? Favorite it!

[b]To read your favorites, just click the new heart icon.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/6f90d322afd571b0c2a52105dea03b57f64df79d.gif[/img]

Currently you are limited to having 500 favorites. We will be looking at feedback, player behavior and server load to see if that's the right limit. You can always remove favorites to make more room.

We've also added a handful of other improvements, because, gosh darn it, you're worth it.

[h3]Full Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a favorites system
[*] Moved the screensavers button to the "more" section
[*] Updated help page text and links
[*] Letter response font will auto-size if it's too long to fit on the page
[*] Changed the quit icon from a pillow to an open door
[*] Changed the decorate room icon from a face to a room
[*] Made camera grain effect stay constant with screen resolution changes
[*] Made the request input field behave like airplanes and responses when reaching the size limit
[*] Fixed a soft lock that could occur if making a report failed
[*] Fixed an issue checking the validity of a sticker granted by a thanks
[*] Replaced Twitter link with [url=https://mastodon.gamedev.place/@popcannibal]Mastodon link[/url]
[*] Removed the "3 Year" badge. Cause it's 4 years now.
[/list]

With much gratitude for our players who are [i]our favorites[/i],

Ziba & Luigi

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/34d0e9971ae25988f5342105827499f6edbf7059.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/2b9fca7d61ca278afe2fb04f92d1357bf7e3699e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Scheduled Downtime: 8/8/23 11pm GMT-4 for 4 hours
notes.notes:
[h2][h1]Short version: [/h1][/h2]

Gotta turn off Kind Words for a few hours to update the server. 
Also, there's a small, fun update to the game coming soon.

[h2][h1]Long version:[/h1][/h2]

If you've been following along with our folksy little updates all these years, you may be familiar with this theme: We didn't expect Kind Words to be popular and I didn't design the server thinking lots of people would actually use it.  That caused some growing pains for all of us. 

A few [i]years[/i] ago I started rewriting the server for better performance and extensibility. I don't want to jinx it, but I've [i]actually tested[/i] the new server for high loads unlike when we launched the current one.

It's going to take a few hours to do the upgrade because our database is around 7 gigabytes in size and I don't want to lose any of your messages. So first I'm gonna backup the existing database, which takes about a half hour. Then I need to convert the database to my totally redesigned format. That should take about an hour.

Let's assume something will go wrong, double that and add a little and I'm estimating 4 hours.

Boy do I hope nothing goes wrong.

The best thing about this server update is that it will let us do some new things with the game. And I know that everyone longs to open steam to be greeted by a monologue about server upgrades, so to thank you for your attention, I'm going to reward you with a tease for our next game update: we're adding a "favorites" system so you can curate your own little collection of the kindest of words.

notes.title: 3 years!
notes.notes:
This week marks 3 years since Kind Words launched! That's 3 years and over 5 million letters and airplanes shared between strangers lifting each other up. While it's amazing to us that Kind Words found an audience, it's shocking and humbling to us that you're all still here! After all this time, you're still writing thousands of messages every day! 

I still can't believe we get to facilitate this wacky experiment-turned-way-of-life. Luigi and I try to honor that privilege by moderating the game 7 days a week. Being such a small team, we're especially grateful to the community members in game, discord and forums who help with questions. 

One funny side effect of the never ending parade of new users is that statistically unlikely problems become, well, more likely! Lightning strikes, cosmic radiation, internet gremlins, literal bugs inside computers. None of those seemed important to prepare for in 2019 when we were making a game we thought 100 people would play. 

Anyways, that's my excuse for why a mangled save file could confuse the game and prevent it from running. Today's update includes a much better effort at making Kind Words save files fault tolerant.  

If Valve accidentally turns all your cloud saves in to cat jpgs, Kind Words will no longer overwrite your local save with it and try to load it.  

If you cut and paste a recipe for baked cod over your local save file. Kind Words can't bring it back. I'm not magic. But at least now it won't just stop working, it will open the save file manager and explain that it can't read the save file. 

We also included a cute little 3 year celebration emblem on the title screen.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/605fa26c91303d60e5e37210d035da93cf2f39b8.png[/img]

Thank you so much for being a part of this. Your support has motivated and empowered us to keep Kind Words running and to work on other projects, some public (wishlist Cyrano!) and others that we're not ready to talk about just yet 😉 

Keep on being kind. 
 
Yours, 
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: Save File Manager
notes.notes:
How sexy is that, right? We added a save file manager! 
Even better:[i] I recommend you never ever use it![/i] 
Wow! These updates just get better and better!

In all seriousness, for 99% of people you don't need to ever think twice about your save file. There should be only one and there should be no problem with it.

However, this save file manager is for you if:
* You're on a mac and your save file seems to have disappeared recently.
* You don't use steam cloud but you manually copy save files between computers.
* Something really weird that shouldn't have happened, happened.

This new tool, accessed from the options page, will help you discover and select what save file to use.

Hopefully on to funnerer stuff now!

notes.title: Screensaver font scaling and MacOS steam cloud fix.
notes.notes:
I finally fixed Steam Cloud Saves on MacOS. Sorry it took so long. I had to do some things. Like get a mac.

As a tiny bonus, I've added a font size slider to the screensaver modes for all platforms.

Fun fact: the screensaver mode was something I wrote in partnership with the Science Gallery in Melbourne for an [url=https://melbourne.sciencegallery.com/mental-exhibits/kind-words]exhibit they made on Kind Words[/url]. I like to leave it running on an old screen in my kitchen so I can walk by and see people's words of encouragement throughout the day… and so that I know the server is still running and I don't have to panic.

Technical Caveat:
If you used cloud save previously and then started fresh on a mac without cloud save, your old cloud save file may now come back and overwrite your fresh start. Don't worry, the game will detect this and backup your fresh save as kindwords.json1. You can verify that this is what happened by looking for kindwords.json1 in the same directory that the game will display to you when you use the "export" function.

If that happens and you wish to replace your old cloud save with your fresh start, use the in-game option to completely delete your current save. Close the game and then replace kindwords.json with kindwords.json1.

Hopefully this won't affect anyone and I'm being paranoid. But not losing your letters is pretty important to me. As always, reach me at support@popcannibal.com or [url=discord.gg/popcannibal]discord.gg/popcannibal[/url] if you have questions.

notes.title: The report button is for reports, not replies ;) 您不能使用“REPORT”按钮回复他人。
notes.notes:
Well this is a cute little [i]very specific[/i] update. In the last few days we've had an influx of players from China! Welcome!

You're doing a great job being kind to each other, but a number of players have gotten one thing confused: The report button sends messages to ME and LUIGI, the moderators.  It does NOT send a message to the person you are reporting. You can't use the report button to talk back to people. Sorry!

This update adds one-time-only message from Ella the Mail deer when you make a report to remind you that you're sending a report to the moderators and not to another player.

I hope this is a proper translation :

You can not reply to people using the "REPORT" button.

您不能使用“REPORT”按钮回复他人。

This update also changes the description on the Abe Lincoln sticker to use the word "enslaved" instead of "slaves", because in this context we are talking about a burden put upon people and not an all encompassing definition of who they were. Thank you to the player who made that suggestion!

There's also a tiny increment in the version of Unity used for this release. Shouldn't change anything. Probably.

That's all for this update. I know it's been a while since we've had a meatier update. It may surprise absolutely no one who follows me to learn that I've been rewriting parts of the backend AGAIN. Lots of invisible work going on behind the scenes to make sure Kind Words has a long life and a stable foundation on which to grow.

Cheers!
Ziba

notes.title: New writing game from the makers of Kind Words: Cyrano!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/5334223513cc73b9599c5e3f1bd7e97c3a6019c0.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1750470/Cyrano/]Wishlist Cyrano now![/url][h1][/h1]

Are you enjoying writing nice letters in Kind Words? But maybe you wish you could wander outside of reality for a few minutes and write about a burning, passionate, ill-fated love? Also maybe poke a few dudes with swords? Insult some fools? And collect cards?!

What we've done is make a one hour adaptation of the classic tragicomedy, Cyrano de Bergerac. It's a funny, heartbreaking story about a writer with more wits than beauty who fights the whole world with swords and words.

It's my personal favorite play and my primary motivation for making this game was to spread access to what I know is good in this world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/9bb99a89e5b49b7f7f9a43106254ad0a0b1952c7.png[/img]

It's a play about writing, and I thought: I know some people who like writing!

More than just a straight up copy of the play, we've made room for you to be the heart of the production. You will [i]use your words[/i] to express your love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/44cf5946d9b8a67177b533e65afb85221e5f68e8.gif[/img]

You may have caught a glimpse of this game this spring. Our friends at Fellow Traveller commissioned Cyrano and featured it in their Ludonarracon festival. Well, this winter we're self publishing it for everyone to play. Translated in to 7 languages, no less!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/97cabfc498d862fbf6263cad6e17a0a9f3890ab2.gif[/img]

Just like Kind Words, it's Luigi making art, Clark making music and me (Ziba) on the rest. It's short, it'll be cheap, and it's one of the greatest stories ever told. Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1750470/Cyrano/]wishlist Cyrano now![/url]

notes.title: Small fixes: Duck Kami sticker, deleting responses and changing signature.
notes.notes:
Small fixes:
[list]
[*] Stopped the Duck Kami sticker from looking like a Bleeper when you put it on a letter.
[*] Fixed not being able to delete responses if your inbox was sorted by request.
[*] Changing your signature initial used to have a delay before being reflected locally.
[*] Clicking on the version on the title screen now takes you to the steam news page instead of the static game website.
[/list]

That's all. If you're like me, you might have noticed an update for a game you care about and then clicked on the news only to be slightly disappointed that it's just bugfixes for bugs you didn't even notice.
Sorry. That's all that needed changing right now. But I CAN give you a little update on some behind the scenes dev stuff if you're just hungry for some Kind Words goings on.

Moderation is a big job for us and we take it seriously. We're always looking for ways to do it better and more efficiently.

You ever read those jokes where it's like: "We fed 10,000 movie scripts in to an AI and asked it to write Robocop 5!"

Well... we've actually got the sort of dataset with Kind Words that just might be right for that kind of AI. We've got around 4 million organized text entries and 200,000 moderation actions. Now, "feeding it to an AI and asking it to moderate" isn't entirely straight forward. There's a bit of data science and statistics to do. And the biggest catch is: I need to do it myself. We take our privacy policy very seriously. I'm never going to hand off our database to a third party, no matter how good they are at feeding it to machines.

So that's what I've been up to. Dusting off my python. Reading up on support-vector machines. Connecting PHP and Python in ways God never intended. I've got a LONG way to go, but I'm excited to say I did a first test in the production environment today and it has already flagged several questionable messages for review. I don't know if it'll ever get to the point where I trust it to make final decisions, but damn is it cool to be trying.

Cheers,
Ziba

notes.title: Pink Lemonade
notes.notes:
[h2]Two years in and over 4 million messages sent![/h2] 

[h3]If you're not gonna stop then we're not gonna either![/h3] 
New stickers for everybody! You get a three-eyed duck thing! And a sleepy octopus! And .... a jelly...cube...with... bones? Maybe those are french fries. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/f18aec2f486131f492d3618e2ea5eaffa49e3c55.gif[/img]

Because Kind Words is a chill place and strives to be a bit of the opposite of traditional social media, we don't flash a lot of numbers in the game. No online player count. No ticker with announcements or tournaments. [i](note to self: what would a Kind Words tournament be?)[/i] So every now and then we get two questions:
[olist]
[*] Is anyone playing Kind Words?
[*] Is anyone moderating Kind Words?
[/olist]
The answer to both is: heck yes, all the time.

Usage goes up and down, but on a slow day, we're still transmitting a couple thousand letters between players. 

And we are moderating constantly and always improving our moderation tools. For every update to the game, I make 10 updates to the backend. Faster, smarter, stronger, purpler. Also, we. Hold on. Duck...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/f1fbd6d9b2d92bd09f80031ef40a374d28c62422.png[/img]

First, we're letting people directly delete responses they no longer want to have in their inboxes.

Second, we're going to ask you to confirm some things before you try to do them like... are you trying to send a stranger your discord handle? Or your email? And we'll gently remind you that we gotta keep it anonymous to keep it safe.

Full change notes:
[list]
[*] New room!
[*] New stickers!
[*] Added the ability to delete responses you've received.
[*] Sorted unopened letters to show up on top of your pile.
[*] Will ask you to confirm before sending if it looks like you're breaking rules.
[*] Prevented the escape key from erasing what you just typed.
[*] Updated to Unity 2020.3.16
[/list]

Thanks once more for living this wild experiment in caring with us.

Yours,
Ziba & Luigi

notes.title: "Trolls need kind words the most"
notes.notes:
In 2019, a team of three people released a game on Steam as a kind of experiment, an unusual game about anonymously writing and receiving letters from other real people in the world. It was called Kind Words. I wrote about it at the time.

The team, Popcannibal, didn't think it would make much of an impact. Maybe 2000 people would play before it faded away. "We were wrong," co-founder Ziba Scott said in a talk at GDC this week. "It was a huge success.

"People showed up to play in their thousands right away and haven't stopped in over a year-and-a-half now. Players poured their hearts out. It quickly became very personal and dark, and silly, and just everything. All of humanity showed up: loving, angry, confused, messy, suicidal, depressed, giddy, playful - everything. And strangers diligently replied."

Read more

We're at a year and change now and you haven't slowed down! You're still writing each other[i][b] thousands of messages every day[/b][/i].

We are humbled to have Kind Words become a regular part of so many people's lives and, in keeping with long-standing international custom for developer-player relations, we offer you this traditional gift: a giant, looming beast and some mittens.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/53f0b4b0c46feb1ff753e8090f5e9d3a0645c0dc.jpg[/img]

[*] Steam trading cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35372461/ea1d1ae4a72abdec88f609532890231bac3fd896.gif[/img]

[*] The request list is refreshed every time you view it.
[*] Fixed a bug which could cause new stickers not to get the big fanfare they deserve when first seen.

notes.title: Kind Words is a beautiful game about helping real people by writing letters
notes.notes:
Kind Words is one of the most beautiful games I've ever played - beautiful in its intent. It's a game about helping other people, about writing encouraging letters to each other and sharing worries.

It's very simple (and cheap: 4). You're a cartoony character in a warmly coloured little bedroom, adrift in a sort of dreamspace, and you sit at a desk, sending and receiving letters. They're not long letters, more like memos, and they're delivered via an adorable postal deer. Yes, a deer.

I browsed other people's letters to begin with. They're anonymous so all you know of the other person is an initial of their name (which is probably made up), and then it's up to you whether to reply. You might not have anything to say, but some problems might be exactly what you've been through, so maybe you have advice to share.

Read more

notes.title: 250,000 Letters!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/0b645efe87ea73cac647a79f68f9df7fd1005448.gif[/img]

[h1]A Quarter Million![/h1]

You kind people have already written [b]250,000 letters[/b] to each other! 

When we dreamed up this little trust experiment, we never imagined it would get this big. In fact, before launch I did a stress test on the server with 60,000 fake messages and laughed to myself [i]"hah, we'll NEVER get close to that"[/i].

(Thank you all for bearing with us through brief server meltdown that followed.)

It has been a crazy few weeks improving the servers, fixing bugs, streamlining our moderator tools, and talking to hundreds people on [url=discord.gg/popcannibal]discord[/url], email, [url=twitter.com/popcannibal]twitter[/url] and [url=reddit.com/r/kindwords]reddit[/url]!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
It's a bit overwhelming, but we've been lifted up by your enthusiasm, positivity and fan art. More importantly, thank you for what you're doing for each other. It's a privilege for us to be facilitating such heart warming exchanges as are happening every minute through Kind Words.

[h1]Now more![/h1]
We're blinking the joyful sparkles of astonishment out of our eyes now and getting back to work. THERE WILL BE MORE STICKERS! Just you wait and see ;)

Fun fact, I took so long making that sexy looping celebratory video that you've actually hit 271k already!

You can see the video with sound [url=twitter.com/popcannibal/status/1178819502802378753]on twitter[/url]

notes.title: Kind Words lets you share caring messages with strangers
notes.notes:
The chatrooms of lo fi hip hop YouTube radio channels are often very sweet spaces. People mingle, letting each other know what they re up to as they listen to the ambient sounds: work, studying, relaxing. Everyone doing their own thing, but united by some chillhop beats and the virtual space of the chat window.

It makes sense, then, that Kind Words draws attention to the fact that it uses that kind of music in its soundtrack via its subtitle, (lo fi chill beats to write to). It’s a game about sharing uplifting letters with real strangers. You hang out in a hazy, cosy looking bedroom, scribbling away in response to others worries, or ask for responses to your own nagging thoughts. Also there s a friendly postdeer.

(more…)

notes.title: Kind Words is a sweet game about supporting strangers
notes.notes:
Kind Words is a peculiar game about writing nice letters to real strangers while listening to chill music. There's no pressure, tension or objectives—you just relax in your cozy bedroom, scribbling away. It's incredibly sweet, with a surreal but reassuring atmosphere. A deer delivers your mail! I love it. 

If you're tense or upset and don't feel like you can share your worries with people you know, you can jot things down in Kind Words and send your letter out into the community, at which point they go into the request queue and people can respond with words of encouragement.

Alternatively, you can also fire off a paper airplane, which can be sent to individuals or to the community in general. If you've just got good vibes to share or you want to thank someone for helping you, just launch one of them out of your window. 

As well as sharing fears or advice, players can also share stickers. Everyone starts with some random stickers in their inventory, which can then be sent to other players or stuck on letters. If someone sends you a new sticker, you can copy it and share it with others. Stickers also let you add a bit more character to your bedroom, as they all come with a toy that you can pop on your bed or a shelf. 

New to the launch version is an export to HTML feature, which conveniently lets you save letters, keeping them with you when you're not playing the game. If you're out and about and need a little pick-me-up, you can just bring up the webpage on your phone. 

Sometimes it's just nice to have people rooting for you, even if they're invisible strangers in a game. And despite the potential for abuse, the community seems to be overwhelmingly lovely and sincere. It only launched yesterday, but prior to that there were still thousands of people writing letters to each other, and so far there don't appear to have been problems. 

There is a report feature, too, which sends the letter to the developer and removes it from your list. It might need to be used more now that it's officially released, but hopefully not. 

Kind Words is out now on Steam.

notes.title: [Kind Words] Starts Now
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/954898ac1430d8cdd880a0c418f7be992c952d77.gif[/img]
[h1][Kind Words] (lo fi chill beats to write to) is now available on Steam![/h1]

We believe people want to lift each other up. This is your chance. 

Over the last 2 months our Humble players have written over 50,000 messages to each other in Kind Words. They shared fears, joys, loss, exhaustion...everything. But most of all: encouragement.

[h1]Export to HTML[/h1]
Now you can click a button and all the letters you've received will be downloaded and saved in a pretty little webpage on your computer. 

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Room decorations do a little dance when you click on them
[*] Added Australian mental health resources
[*] Remaining line indicator when writing
[*] Prevented accidentally fast closing paper airplanes by double clicking
[/list]

notes.title: Kind Airplanes?!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6857515/2edcc02ea4d5ed0456458166d040d8b21662d1d6.gif[/img]

Big update today for Kind Words Steam beta testers and Humble owners!

[h1]Paper Airplanes![/h1]

One of the weirdest, most wonderful problems I've ever had in my entire game design career is that Kind Words has too many people just bubbling over with kindness and clogging up the request queue with loving statements of support and joy!

What am I supposed to do, tell you to stop?! 

So today you get paper airplanes. These airplanes are just the place for you to send your thanks to the world, to an individual, share an inspirational quote, or maybe even just scream and vent some strong emotions.

Your words will fly through everybody else's worlds and everyone can click on them to read our shared stream of thoughts.


[h1]Full History[/h1]
Your inbox only shows you the newest responses to your requests for letters. This helps keep things speedy for the servers. Now there's also a full history browser that will let you chronologically browse all your requests and responses, no matter how many.

[h1]More[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam cloud saving!
[*] Updated mixes for all music tracks!
[*] Music volume slider!
[*] More reporting options!
[*] Secret stuff that's not unlocked yet but might turn out to be new stickers. Who knows?!
[/list]

It's been a fantastic couple months leading up to the full Steam launch. Over 40,000 letters written! You folks are the best. Keep being kind and get hyped for beautiful new players you'll be talking to after the upcoming release!
